description: We are RPS Group 3, participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge in Lusaka, Zambia. Our challenge is “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map.” We are passionate about space exploration, coding, and technology. Our goal is to create an interactive guide exploring how humans could survive on Mars. We welcome creative, enthusiastic members interested in programming, design, research, science, and problem-solving. Together, we aim to turn ideas into innovation!
